notes: OpenAlex and NORA (the Danish National Open Research Analytics team) jointly announced a collaboration mapping the OpenAlex research classification system to the OECD Fields of Research and Development (FORD) taxonomy, supporting the launch of the new Danish research portal. NORA is a national initiative funded by the Danish Agency for Higher Education and Science (UFS), with the team located at Statistics Denmark. NORA is preparing a consolidated national research database that integrates OpenAlex alongside institutional data sources and Scopus/SciVal data enriched with CWTS indicators — so OpenAlex is being adopted in parallel with, not as a replacement for, Elsevier products.
